scope: Scaled homogeneous native HexGen experiment with 1024 HTTP streams per peer; not the paper 70B result.
hardware: Two separate hosts with one Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB each
attention: Regular attention; flash-attn 2.0.8 installed for native model/helper modules, FlashAttention kernels disabled
network: NCCL socket transport on private Ethernet; RDMA disabled
serving: Authors OCF head/worker coordinators with bounded resource and error-response patch; NATS, rank-based LlamaWorker, original decode and request_head_node client

dataset.selection_policy: First user message only; trim outer whitespace; all languages; exclude prompts shorter than 127 text tokens; deduplicate text and truncated token sequences; sample 500 without replacement; prepend BOS and keep the first 127 text tokens; no assistant text, padding, or concatenation.

input_adaptation.replacement_policy: Preserve 496 compatible records in place; replace four incompatible records with the first unused, round-trip-safe eligible records in source-row order.

arrivals: Authors historical PossoinWorkLoad generator; same first 500 seeded unit-rate offsets divided by each RPS; asynchronous native client calls; native server queueing; drain every rate.
base_measurement: Median native rank-0 inference duration: tokenization excluded; includes synchronized distributed prefill and 32-token decode, and wait for the initial rank barrier. One TP=2 replica across two RTX 6000 hosts; isolated requests through OCF.

metric_definitions.end_to_end_latency: Scheduled arrival to full response; includes submission lag, native queueing, network and inference.
metric_definitions.throughput: Successful requests divided by time from first scheduled arrival through final completion; includes drain.
metric_definitions.memory: Largest per-request peak PyTorch allocation on either GPU, including weights; excludes unused cached reservation and driver memory.
metric_definitions.slo: Percentage of offered requests finished by multiplier times the fresh TP=2 base reference.

limitations: Native OCF HTTP-per-peer resource limits explicitly raised to 1024 streams and 512 MiB; original transport error handling corrected.
Smaller model, fewer GPUs and cross-host TP differ from the paper.
Regular attention on Turing, not FlashAttention GPU kernels.
Controlled LMSYS subset; exact paper subset and live Figure 2 harness unavailable.
One finite trial per rate, no repeat-trial confidence intervals; overload results include finite queue drain.

baseline_summary.definition: Median native rank-0 inference duration: tokenization excluded; includes synchronized distributed prefill and 32-token decode, and wait for the initial rank barrier. One TP=2 replica across two RTX 6000 hosts; isolated requests through OCF.

publication.description: Public export of the completed native RTX Red run. Prompt text omitted; retained CSV values, metrics and plots unchanged. No new GPU experiment.
publication.source_hashes_describe: Frozen measured source; the PR subsequently makes paths and endpoints configurable. This is not a GPU run of the publication commit.
publication.directory_naming: expNum_seqLen_reqRate_deploy; expNum enumerates full-suite runs 01 through 07 in ascending request-rate order. The pilot is separate.
publication.request_ids: Historical request IDs are unchanged; their prefixes refer to original evidence directory names.
